description: Last login timestamp stored as string despite representing datetime values. Contains 30 records with 0 missing values (100% complete) and 28 distinct values spanning from 2019-01-01 to 2024-05-12. All observed values consistently display midnight time (00:00:00), suggesting either date-only recording or truncated time components. Values are uniformly 19 characters following YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format, with 2 legitimate duplicate timestamps observed.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert data type from string to datetime64[ns] to enable proper temporal filtering, sorting, and date arithmetic operations.

[CLARIFY] Confirm whether the constant '00:00:00' time component indicates that only dates are recorded (with default midnight timestamps) or if time-of-day data is missing; consider converting to date-only type if time precision is not collected.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the format: 4-digit year, hyphen, 2-digit month, hyphen, 2-digit day, space, '00:00:00' — e.g., '2023-03-30 00:00:00'.
